title: AuthZ telemetry proxy and policy-shard evaluator
creator: Ava Brooks
description: Build a lightweight telemetry proxy paired with a horizontally sharded policy-evaluator to provide low-latency, auditable authorization decisions across API, runtime, and Console surfaces. This ticket covers design, a production-proof-of-concept, and an incremental rollout strategy that preserves current RBAC v2 semantics while introducing: (1) a thin telemetry proxy that enriches each authz request with identity traces (SAML/SSO attributes, session id, request route), (2) a policy-shard evaluator that stores partitioned rulesets and executes evaluation close to serving nodes (no mandatory sidecar), (3) an audit-enrichment pipeline that attaches evaluation metadata (policy-version, explain data, latency) to existing audit logs, and (4) admin-aware emergency overrides and safe fallbacks for degraded evaluator availability. Goal: reduce median authorization latency by >=15% for high-throughput routes and make decision traces available in the console audit view for compliance investigations.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry proxy accepts signed identity assertions from SSO layer and attaches canonical identity to eval requests
Policy-shard evaluator returns decisions with explain payload and policy_version in <= 8ms p50 for simple allow/deny checks on standard hardware
Audit logs contain enriched fields: policy_version, decision_explain_id, evaluated_rules_count, shard_id, evaluator_latency_ms
When evaluator cluster is partially unavailable, runtime falls back to cached decisions with a TTL-based stale policy indicator visible in audit traces
Console audit view surfaces decision_id links that fetch explain payloads from the telemetry proxy service
Admin emergency override endpoint exists and requires two-person approval via console flow (audit entries created for override requests)
notes: 2026-02-22: Spike completed — compared monolithic evaluator vs sharded approach; sharding with consistent hashing reduces mean eval queue time under load by ~22% in our sim
2026-02-25: Security review kickoff scheduled; initial threat model highlights sensitive fields in SAML assertions and the need for end-to-end encryption between SSO, proxy, and evaluator
2026-03-02: POC wire-up done; telemetry proxy forwards explainable decisions and attaches decision_id to audit sink; storage schema for explains settled (compressed JSON blobs keyed by decision_id)
2026-03-08: Load test: with 4 shards we hit 120k evals/sec sustained; p95 latency for explainable checks is 28ms; action: optimize explain generation path to lower tail latency
2026-03-11: UX session with Console PM — decision_id will link to read-only explain view and include 'stale_policy' flag if fallback used

Implementation trade-offs: prefer eventual consistency for policy propagation to shards to reduce rollout complexity; will provide canary rollout for policy-version updates and synchronous blocking update for high-critical policies only
